_comment: Copy this file to manifest.json and edit. One row per demo asset. Values for locale/campaign/visualStyle become Contentful tags like locale_en_US, campaign_summer_sale, visualStyle_editorial. assetKey is the stable Contentful sys.id used as the DMO primary key — keep it short and kebab-free (letters, numbers, _, -).
